# Clerk E2E testing with Playwright and Cypress

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @clerk's official guide for E2E-testing Clerk apps: the mental model of test auth as isolated session state, `clerkSetup()` and `setupClerkTestingToken()` to bypass bot detection, reusing auth state with `storageState` for speed, the Playwright (`globalSetup`) vs Cypress (`addClerkCommands`) specifics, and an anti-patterns table (production keys in tests, UI sign-in on every test).
